prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after adoption consistently degraded performance across 2 tests and was stopped early due to worsening sign-in rates.
Home wait-time info (4 wins across 7 tests), adoption redesigns (2 wins across 4 tests), and finish redesigns (2 wins across 6 tests) proved helpful, though several tests in these categories showed no clear effect.
Changes to choose-path copy (3 tests), sign-in copy (2 tests), and sign-in hints (4 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Choose-path layout modifications (4 tests) and sign-in notifications (4 tests) consistently showed no clear effect or degraded performance.
Categories with only a single test (such as adoption incentives, adoption notifications, or finish notifications) still provide thin evidence.
Predictions consistently underestimated major winning tests while overestimating changes that yielded no clear effect or degraded performance.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] new_screen_pet_visibility_basics: Adds a dedicated onboarding screen after home intro showing users how to locate, minimize, and toggle their pet on the desktop. (why: Support receives multiple emails about pets not displaying on desktop or users not knowing how to control or hide their pet after setup.)
1: [home, wait_info] waiting_render_milestone_info: Displays stage milestone information and estimated time during long pet creation renders. (why: Home waiting screen has a high median time (201s) and mean time (2336s). Clear progress context helps set expectations.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] pick_friend_story_preview_flow: Introduces a story preview flow where pet choices are presented within interactive story panels. (why: Adoption step takes a median of 89s and can cause drop-off; previewing companion storylines makes character selection clearer.)
3: [finish, redesign] home_intro_desktop_navigation_redesign: Redesigns the final onboarding screen around desktop control shortcuts and navigation cards. (why: Users report confusion post-onboarding about controlling, hiding, or interacting with their pet.)
4: [adoption, new_flow] upload_photos_quality_guidance_flow: Adds explicit photo upload requirements and dynamic preview guidance before custom pet generation. (why: Support logged 3 tickets where custom pet generation failed or resulted in visual errors due to poor photo inputs.)
5: [home, notification] waiting_desktop_status_notification: Adds an option on the render wait screen to send a system notification when generation finishes. (why: The average wait time on the home waiting screen exceeds 35 minutes (2336s), leading users to idle or abandon the application.)
6: [adoption, redesign] adoption_certificate_desktop_placement_redesign: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a desktop placement card layout with preview indicators. (why: Adoption completion leads directly into desktop rendering, where user drop-off occurs if placement expectations are unclear.)
7: [choose_path, new_flow] story_welcome_companion_flow: Rebuilds the introductory story flow to highlight desktop companion features prior to path selection. (why: Choose path drop-off is 21.2% with a mean duration of 514s, indicating initial user hesitation or lack of context.)
8: [home, redesign] waiting_screen_render_progress_checklist: Redesigns the waiting screen layout into a checklist format showing real-time preparation steps. (why: Home stage has high wait times; dynamic progress indicators reduce perceived wait times and improve completion rates.)
